_comment: Real-box benchmark targets. Copy to targets.json and fill in boxes you are AUTHORIZED to scan (HTB / TryHackMe authorize their own machines; nothing else is in scope). Run: python3 benchmark.py --targets targets.json  (implies --execute; be on the VPN). Ground truth is what you confirmed after rooting the box — ports are the keys, service names the values; versions are optional. 'injection' stays false for real boxes (they carry no planted payloads).
